questions.explanation: The why mass does not set the fall time in a vacuum principle here is: Set mg equal to ma. On that basis "Weight is mg, so F=ma becomes mg=ma, canceling m and giving a=g independent of mass" is correct.

questions.stem: Two cars move perpendicular at 3 m/s and 4 m/s. Relative speed magnitude?

questions.topic: Acceleration is a change of velocity, not of speed
questions.stem: In uniform circular motion, acceleration is directed?

options.misconception: confuses constant speed with zero accel

questions.explanation: Centripetal acceleration points toward center. Tangential acceleration is zero in uniform circular motion.
